title: On-call callstack snapshot proxy and deferred action queue
author: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: On-call workflows frequently need to attach compact callstack/trace snapshots to incident cards with minimal noise and without leaking raw traces. Additionally, responders asked for a nonblocking mechanism to enqueue follow-up actions (safety-runbooks, delayed mitigations) that can be persisted if the bot process restarts.

Proposal: Add a lightweight snapshot proxy that accepts pre-sanitized callstack zips and stores a small indexed metadata record (sha256, size, kind, tags) in the incident-bot attachment store while forwarding the raw payload to object storage. Consumers get a compact reference/preview and can fetch full payloads on-demand. Pair this with a deferred action queue that persists queued actions to the same storage layer (leveldb backup + S3 snapshot) and provides at-least-once processing with idempotency keys.

What this PR includes: consolidated proxy handler, attachment metadata index, deferred action queue implementation, e2e tests, CLI tooling to inspect/dequeue actions, and documentation for on-call runbook authors.

Checklist:
- [x] Snapshot proxy HTTP handler + validations
- [x] Attachment metadata index and compact preview generator
- [x] DeferredAction queue with durable backing and retry policy
- [x] CLI utilities for ops (inspect, replay, drain)
- [x] Unit and e2e tests for happy path and transient failure
- [x] Docs: oncall/deferred-actions.md and snapshot handling guidance

Backward compatibility: Proxy is gated behind a feature flag (ONCALL_SNAPSHOT_PROXY). Existing attachment endpoints remain unchanged. Deferred queue is opt-in per team and uses a separate backlog prefix. No schema breaking changes to incident card payloads; we add an optional attachment_ref object when available.

Rollout plan: feature flag -> dark launch for 48h (index-only) -> enable fetch endpoints for SRE tooling -> enable CLI drain by runbook owners.

Related: ENG-1289 (on-call attachments roadmap), ENG-1301 (deferred automation MVP).

release_notes: Add opt-in on-call snapshot proxy and durable deferred action queue; operators can store compact attachment references and enqueue follow-up actions for resilient automation.
notes: Dark-launch behind ONCALL_SNAPSHOT_PROXY. Ops should run `incident-bot inspect deferred` to view queued actions. See docs/oncall/deferred-actions.md for CLI workflow and recovery steps.
